# uniteTOlove — full index

> A citizen-built, AI-assisted civic knowledge project for Toronto's 2026 municipal election and beyond — backgrounders, an open government registry, and open data. Published under the byline The Unknown Soldier. No donations asked for anywhere.

This is a fuller INDEX, not the site's full text. Concatenating every rendered page here would be large and lower-fidelity than the source itself; for full text, read the public source repo directly: https://github.com/unitetolove/commons (raw markdown, no HTML). This file mechanically walks every section this site's own navigation carries (tools/site_nav.py), plus live page counts per generated corpus — regenerated on every run, never hand-maintained.

## Source (cleanest text)

- [https://unitetolove.ca/commons.html](https://unitetolove.ca/commons.html): A map of what's in the commons repo, for builders and agents.
- [https://github.com/unitetolove/commons](https://github.com/unitetolove/commons): The commons repo — the public mirror in source form: sealed research markdown, cleaned datasets, frameworks, docs. Start here for raw text, not HTML.
- [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitetolove/commons/main/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitetolove/commons/main/README.md): What's in the repo and what's coming.
- [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitetolove/commons/main/docs/methodology.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitetolove/commons/main/docs/methodology.md): How claims are sourced and verified.
- [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitetolove/commons/main/docs/ai-disclosure.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitetolove/commons/main/docs/ai-disclosure.md): How AI assistance is used and disclosed.
- [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitetolove/commons/main/docs/corrections-policy.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitetolove/commons/main/docs/corrections-policy.md): How corrections are handled.
- [https://github.com/unitetolove/commons/tree/main/research](https://github.com/unitetolove/commons/tree/main/research): Sealed research markdown: wiki, briefs, explainers, discussion guides, state-of-the-election, transit, questions.
- [https://github.com/unitetolove/commons/tree/main/data](https://github.com/unitetolove/commons/tree/main/data): Cleaned civic datasets, schema included.
- [https://github.com/unitetolove/commons/tree/main/frameworks](https://github.com/unitetolove/commons/tree/main/frameworks): Permanent Culture and the Toronto mobilization framework, public-principles tier.
- [https://github.com/unitetolove/commons/tree/main/guides](https://github.com/unitetolove/commons/tree/main/guides): The Free Toronto resource guides, sealed families.

## By the numbers (live, this run)

- 818 Government Atlas org/level pages — https://unitetolove.ca/gov-atlas/

- 145 recommendation cards — https://unitetolove.ca/cards/
- 80 wiki issue pages — https://unitetolove.ca/wiki/
- 40 Free Toronto guide pages — https://unitetolove.ca/guides/
- 29 transit report chapters — https://unitetolove.ca/transit/
- 1 Explained Simply pages — https://unitetolove.ca/explainers/
- 14 candidate question pages — https://unitetolove.ca/questions/
